title: Workflow diagram
description: Typed interaction flowchart: lanes, columns, edges, and a happy path. The host compiles geometry.
antiPatterns: hand-placing Layer pixels as graph nodes
using Artboard / phone frames as workflow nodes
inventing a router, via points, or a review toolbar
expanding a recipe=design appearance mockup into a flowchart
writing edge.color or Tailwind color classes on edges
agentPrompt: Mount WorkflowDiagram from a typed WorkflowSpec. validateWorkflowSpec; apply only the first supportedFix. No x/y/via/labelAt/fromSide/color. Architecture/sequence stay Mermaid. Device chrome stays recipe=design.
